title: Stacky Hero Master
description: Guide your runner through twisting maze levels, scooping up blocks as you go. Your stack of blocks is also your bridge, so plan a route that collects enough to cross every gap and reach the finish. Each level adds a new layout to figure out.
howto: Click or tap to use the buttons and steer your hero through the maze. Pick up as many blocks as you can before you need to build across a gap.
